external_collaboration.evidence_quote: IQVIA partnered with Alibaba Cloud to become the first life sciences technology company to provide Salesforce-based products in China, enabling us to be compliant with China’s data privacy and residency regulations.

The relationship between IQVIA and Salesforce was established in 2004 and since the early beginnings, IQVIA and Salesforce have continued to expand the partnership. Today, IQVIA is one of Salesforces’ largest customers in Life Sciences and a Salesforce industry SUMMIT Partner globally. Through this partnership Salesforce was awarded IQVIA’s “Partner of the Year Award” in 2021.

IQVIA and Veeva's long-term partnerships help customers improve clinical and commercial efficiency and effectiveness by using software, data, technology and service offerings from IQVIA and Veeva together in a simple and efficient way.
